rationale: The contract pins the six testable acceptance criteria (AC-7 is the repo gate itself, not a fixture). AC-1 (create/list/read/update/disable/enable/delete, every stored field returned) and AC-6 (endpoint behaviour through the real HTTP pipeline and SQLite) are pinned together by JobCrudEndpointsTests and CategoryCrudEndpointsTests, which drive a WebApplicationFactory<Program> instance backed by a temp SQLite file through /api/jobs and /api/categories, plus JobCategoryAssignmentEndpointTests for POST /api/jobs/{id}/categories. AC-2 is JobRunEndpointQueuesOnlyOnRequestTests: POST /api/jobs leaves zero rows in ScrapeRuns, POST /api/jobs/{id}/run adds exactly one queued run and stamps LastQueuedUtc. AC-3 is JobWithoutMarketplaceDefaultsToMercariTests: POST /api/jobs with no marketplace field returns Marketplace Mercari, while the untouched POST /api/scrape/jobs still defaults to Ebay. AC-4 is EffectivelyEnabledJobsQueryTests, a direct SQLite test of ScrapeJobQueryExtensions.WhereEffectivelyEnabled (via JobStore.GetEffectivelyEnabledJobs): a disabled job, a job with only disabled categories, a job with one enabled and one disabled category, and a category-less enabled job — only the last two are returned. AC-5 is JobSchedulingMigrationPreservesExistingDataTests: seeds a database at the pre-existing migration 20260915000000_AddListingBrand with a raw ScrapeJobs row plus a ScrapeRuns row and a Listings row, applies migrations, and asserts all three rows survive with their original values and the legacy job now reads IntervalHours = 24. JobStoreTests and CategoryStoreTests are coverage fixtures (CI0002) exercising every public member of the new JobStore/CategoryStore classes directly against SQLite; they overlap with the HTTP tests deliberately since CI0002 requires literal invocation from a fixture named after the class. The shape declares ScrapeJobEntity's four new members, CategoryEntity, JobCategoryEntity, the DbContext DbSets and relationships, IJobStore/ICategoryStore and their JobStore/CategoryStore implementations (bodies throw NotImplementedException), ScrapeJobQueryExtensions.WhereEffectivelyEnabled (throws NotImplementedException), the AddJobSchedulingAndCategories migration, DI registration, and the /api/jobs and /api/categories minimal-API endpoints in Program.cs. At base the listed test command is red: every JobStore/CategoryStore/query call throws NotImplementedException and every new endpoint 500s, while pre-existing tests (ScrapeStoreTests, SmokeTests, the eBay/Mercari fixtures) stay green because IScrapeStore, ScrapeStore and POST /api/scrape/jobs are untouched. No test reads git or working-tree state.
